# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 2145505399, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> a tiny explorer with a brass spyglass on a hill, reading a large blank banner sign on a distant building across a network of glowing roads at dusk, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark
